sources.title: A Review of Artificial Intelligence in Boiling Heat Transfer ...
sources.snippet: In this context, artificial intelligence (AI), encompassing machine learning and deep learning techniques, has emerged as a powerful paradigm, offering significant advantages in predictive accuracy, data-driven analysis, and experimental efficiency. This paper provides a systematic review of AI applications in boiling heat transfer research.

sources.title: Bubbleformer: Forecasting Boiling with Transformers - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: To our knowledge, Bubbleformer is the first model to demonstrate autonomous, physically plausible forecasting of boiling dynamics. It sets new state-of-the-art benchmarks on both prediction and forecasting tasks in BubbleML 2.0, representing a significant step toward practical, generalizable ML surrogates for multiphase thermal transport.

sources.title: Bubbleformer: Forecasting Boiling with Transformers
sources.snippet: Modeling boiling (an inherently chaotic, multiphase process central to energy and thermal systems) remains a significant challenge for neural PDE surrogates. Existing models require future input (e.g., bubble positions) during inference because they fail to learn nucleation from past states, limiting their ability to autonomously forecast boiling dynamics.
